title: His mother's answer is still quoted a thousand years later | Folio 1 — The Honest Historian #Shorts
description:
When the news was brought to her, the people around her expected screaming, collapse, curses. Instead, she was silent for a moment, and then she said something that Persian speakers still quote a thousand years later. In Beyhaqi's words, she said: what a great man my son was. A king like Mahmud gave him this world, and a king like Masud gave him the next. Think about that. In one sentence, she refused to let the powerful decide what her son's life meant. They had taken his body. They would not take his dignity.

The full story: Folio 1: The Vizier on the Gallows — on our channel and on every podcast app.
